decision_conditions: The Council consider that the impact of the proposed development, by reason of its depth and proximity to the boundary of the site,  would unacceptably harm the amenity of  the adjacent neighbours at Nos.1 & 5 Laburnham Gardens, Upminster by reason of loss of light, outlook and overbearing effect on this property.

This written notice indicates that the proposed development would not comply with condition A.4 of Schedule 2 Part 1 Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015.  It is important to note that this written notice does not indicate whether or not the proposed development would comply with any of the other limitations of conditions of Schedule 2 Part 1 Class A.
The applicant has the right to an appeal against this notice to the Planning Inspectorate, see details below.
Preparation of any further re-submission Informative.

The applicant should note that the proposed eaves height of the flat roof should comply with the MHCLG Permitted development rights for householders Technical Guidance (September 2019) which states that the:

"Eaves height is measured from the ground level at the base of the outside wall to the point where that wall would meet the upper surface of the flat roof - the overhang and the parapet wall should be ignored for the purposes of measurement".
It is unclear from the information provided if the proposal meets this relevant criteria due to the screening effect of the roof verge on either side. Clarity would be sought on any re-submission.
description: Single storey rear extension with an overall depth of 6.00m, a maximum height of 3.64m, and an eaves height of 2.92m (PRIOR APPROVAL)
